newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks gain sharply, dealers eye correction.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks gain sharply, dealers eye correction.

text.p: MADRID, July 2 (Reuter) 1515 GMT - Madrid stocks continued their record run on Wednesday, ending at fresh closing highs which dealers said was more a reflection of the fact that there were few sellers rather than any new incentives to buy. * General index up 9.78 points, 1.61 percent, to 618.36 * Ibex adds 125.03 points, 1.79 percent, to 7,094.94 * Gains concentrated in Repsol, Telefonica, pushing up after a period of underperformance in heavy trade. Telefonica broke key resistance at 4,415 pesetas to end up 125 pesetas to 4,440.

Participants said a correction was due, with the Ibex now more expensive than some core markets. However they could not see when this might emerge, with investment fund flows into the market continuing to push up prices beyond fair values.
